closed_findings: Actual corpus evidence is verified before pilot acceptance and rechecked after execution.
The actual manifest, locations, evidence and review files have before/after anchors.
Required answer and proof negatives include complete contextual source export mutations.
The report itself is included in the final artifact limit via a bounded fixed-point write.
The accepted resolver rules are reconstructed independently from pinned source imports and reviewed root mounts.
The complete accepted configuration identity table is reconstructed from pinned original Git blobs.
Scoped Git enumeration preserves existing startswith semantics for directory and partial basename prefixes, with literal pathspecs and a final complete scope filter.
independent_review.pending: Final frozen-code benchmark, source pilot, indexing, full historical regression and artifact-result review are recorded separately.
